verdict.rationale: Community discussion confirms the existence of an official 'Gemini CLI' used for software development (comm-13, comm-14), but there is no first-party documentation of it in the evidence pack, and a hands-on report shows it fails to work for Workspace accounts ('Failed to login... now as a Workspace account I cant use Gemini CLI for my work') (comm-15). Missing for 10: official CLI documentation/spec, installation and usage guides, and evidence that login/account restrictions have been resolved.
